 Siasat.com / Entertainment / Tollywood News / Three big weddings in Tollywood: Reports Three big weddings in Tollywood: Reports 
 Tollywood star who is reportedly preparing for a wedding is Sai Dharam Tej, nephew of megastar Chiranjeevi
 Rasti Amena Follow on Twitter |   Published: 27th October 2026 4:39 pm IST Chiranjeevi's family Hyderabad : Wedding bells may soon ring for two Tollywood heroes, and the latest buzz has already sparked curiosity among fans. While one young actor is reportedly preparing to take the next step in his relationship, another popular star is said to be getting ready for a new chapter in his personal life. The actors in question are Teja Sajja and Sai Dharam Tej, who are reportedly planning major developments in their personal lives in November.
 However, neither actor has officially confirmed the reports so far.
 Teja Sajja to get engaged to software engineer?
 Teja Sajja, who began his career as a child artist, has established himself as one of the promising young actors in Telugu cinema. The actor shot to fame with the superhero film Hanu-Man, followed by Mirai, further strengthening his position in the industry.
 View this post on Instagram While he is currently associated with Mirai 2 and is also hosting the reality show The Traitors, fresh reports suggest that the actor may soon get engaged.
 According to the buzz, Teja Sajja is likely to get engaged to a software engineer next month. Reports also suggest that the engagement could be followed by a wedding in the near future.
 However, details about the woman, including her identity and whether the match is a love marriage or an arranged marriage, remain unknown. The actor is yet to comment on the reports.
 Sai Dharam Tej to marry childhood friend?
 Another Tollywood star who is reportedly preparing for a wedding is Sai Dharam Tej, nephew of megastar Chiranjeevi.
 View this post on Instagram The actor made his mark in Telugu cinema with films such as Pilla Nuvvu Leni Jeevitham and Subramanyam for Sale. After facing a challenging phase in his career and recovering from a serious bike accident, he made a strong comeback with the thriller Virupaksha.
 Sai Dharam Tej is currently working on Sambaraala Yetigattu. Amid his professional commitments, reports have now emerged that the actor may marry his childhood friend in November.
 While the news has generated curiosity among fans, details about the reported bride and the wedding plans are yet to be officially revealed. The actor has also not confirmed the speculation.
 Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran wedding buzz
 Anirudh and Kavya Maran Meanwhile, reports about an upcoming celebrity wedding have also been doing the rounds in the entertainment industry, with music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran reportedly set to tie the knot.
 According to circulating reports, the wedding is expected to take place in Greece on November 11, followed by a reception in Chennai on November 21. Reports have also claimed that invitations have been extended to several chief ministers from southern states.
 However, the wedding details have not been officially confirmed by the couple.
 With reports surrounding Teja Sajja and Sai Dharam Tej gaining attention, fans are now waiting to see whether the two Tollywood stars will make their personal-life announcements official.
